senses.sense_definition: A prehistoric circular enclosure consisting of a bank and a ditch, often with one or more entrances.

examples.text: Archaeologists discovered a new <w>henge</w> while surveying the field with ground-penetrating radar.
The ancient <w>henge</w> was likely used for ceremonial gatherings during the Neolithic period.

senses.sense_definition: A circular arrangement of standing stones.

examples.text: Tourists from all over the world visit the famous <w>henge</w> to see the massive stones.
The mysterious <w>henge</w> stands silently on the windswept moor.
